commands.name: types-main
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec tsc --project tsconfig.typecheck.json --noEmit --incremental false

commands.name: types-workflow
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec tsc --project tsconfig.workflow-contracts.json --noEmit --incremental false

commands.name: types-smoke
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec tsc --project tsconfig.smoke.json --noEmit --incremental false

commands.name: lint-import
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec biome check src/components/login --formatter-enabled=false

commands.name: format-explicit
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec biome format src/components/login --line-width=100 --line-ending=crlf

commands.name: format-ordinary
commands.command: pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false --dir apps/webapp exec biome format src/components/login
